newsitem.title: UK: New orders emerge in quiet sugar freight market.
newsitem.headline: New orders emerge in quiet sugar freight market.

text.p: A few new orders emerged on the London sugar freight market on Thursday, shipbrokers said.
Reported on subjects were CSR with 16,000 tonnes in bulk Queensland to Japan for April 1-10.
Dreyfus had 26,250 tonnes Cuba-Black Sea or the Baltic Sea and Cargill did 28,000 tonnes in bulk Recife to Black Sea/Egypt or the Baltic Sea for the end of March,
Tate and Lyle had 2,100 tonnes bagged from Thames to Malta also for the end of March
Comet has fixed Khian Star 14,950 dwt for time charter Thailand to the UK but there were no other details.
